tools.name: searchpipe_search
tools.description:
Run an AI-powered web search for a query: SearXNG retrieval → page fetching → LLM reranking → optional AI answer.

Uses the same commercial pipeline as the HTTP POST /search endpoint: authentication → rate limiting →
input moderation → credit charge → search → output moderation + AI-generated marker

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "searchpipe_search" references sensitive artifacts (environment variable, api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: searchpipe_search · Private data: searchpipe_search · Public sink: searchpipe_search · Destructive: searchpipe_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: searchpipe_search · Private data: searchpipe_search · Public sink: searchpipe_search · Destructive: searchpipe_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
